title: Rabbi Dostai of Bei Yeshvav
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Midrash Mishlei, end of chapter 13, asking Rabbi Meir the meaning of “The belly of the wicked shall want.” Pesikta deRav Kahana 59b reads Rabbi Dostai of Kokhvah, and the note there says it should be of Kokhva.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The supplied name מאי is read as Meir: the Buber digital Midrash Mishlei 13 has Rabbi Meir saying “Rabbi Dostai of Bei Yeshvav asked me.” This supports the reading and the question’s direction, without establishing whether the supplied missing resh reflects abbreviation or another letter-level history. The Kokhvah/Kokhva distinction is retained.

The Buber digital Midrash Mishlei 13 explicitly has Rabbi Meir saying that Rabbi Dostai of Bei Yeshvav asked him the meaning of the verse. This supports the English Meir beside supplied מאי, without proving how that spelling arose. Pesikta deRav Kahana 59b and the reported Kokhvah/Kokhva correction remain Hyman’s edition-specific report; that passage and note have not been independently collated here.
